title: Encoded words represent a sum
statement: For every finite list $L$ of natural numbers, encode each entry $m$ by its binary bit string and concatenate the resulting self-delimiting word encodings. The operation that sums the encoded words and decodes the resulting value returns the binary representation of $\sum_{m\in L}m$.
